Name: Hispanic George for Content Patcher
Author: saltedcoffii
Description:
This mod is an adaptation of AllegedMexican's Hispanic George mod for content patcher. Content patcher mods are better for many reasons. See the dangers of using an XNB mod here: https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods

This mod edits the sprite and portrait and a few other things to make George hispanic. Also, check the config.json file for an option to change his name to Jorge!
Also, check out my hispanic Alex mod at: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4988

Please let me know about any bugs/errors.

Thank you so much for downloading! To add, drop into Mods folder. Make sure you have at least Stardew Valley 1.4.0, SMAPI 3.0.0, and Content Patcher 1.11.0 installed! Like the mod? Don't forget to endorse!

Downloads.Description:
Don't forget to endorse the mod!
Still want George -- just different ethnicity? Turn his name change off in config.json
